about: Two baselines in one file. `pages` is the screen family (gap, margin, padding, grid, nesting, contrast), one entry per page state, measured at 1440 x 900. `space` is the space family (Kane's space rule), one entry per scene, measured at all three of 2000 x 1200, 1440 x 900 and 900 x 900; a scene's count is the worst it reaches at any of them. Counts may only go down. `spaceNotes` says why any space count above zero is recorded rather than fixed. See tools/uishot/screencheck.mjs.

spaceNotes.edit-queries: The result card scrolls at 1440 x 900 with about 110 px of its own box empty (114 px hidden on the Visual and Performance states, 12 px in the query editor). It is the fault the 27 September audit measured on Queries and the one page it put out of scope, because a separate lane is redesigning that page; Kane accepted the recording on 27 September and that lane takes every one of these keys to 0. The check could not see it until the space family learned to measure the empty room inside a box instead of only the band under the page's lowest content. Recorded, not hidden: Queries may not get worse. It is the same element on all three keys (div.sem-card.flex-1.min-h-0, the result card whose height comes from the splitter at daxlab.tsx useResizable lab.wbH). The lane that recorded it did change one file this page draws with, the shared result table (grid.tsx, so a narrow result spreads across its box); it did not touch the splitter that gives the card its height, which is what makes the card scroll.
